data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A-stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector founded by Ian Brooke, having raised $27M+ to date. The valuation universe for this segment is limited, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 2 private peers (Boom Supersonic, Hermeus), though the narrow peer set constrains statistical rigor.

Given data limitations, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. This approach uses the $27M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $54M. Peer-median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector; a broader sector median would introduce material bias and was rejected on that basis.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $46M (low) to $62M (high), with a median of $54M. This range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression result but carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the nascency of the commercial supersonic/hypersonic market. Key uncertainties include the timing and probability of near-term inflection events (regulatory approval, customer contracts, technology milestones) and comparability of the limited peer set across technology readiness and revenue stage.
